title: Clicking the "Trash" link in the file deletion notification prompts the "Choose Application" dialog instead of opening Dolphin
line: Clicking "Trash" in a move-to-trash notification now opens the Trash in Dolphin instead of a "Choose Application" dialog.
explanation: A file job notification links its destination, so moving files to the Trash shows "to Trash" with a trash:/ link. Body.qml opened every link with Qt.openUrlExternally, which hands it to the desktop portal; no application declares the trash: scheme, so the portal asks with its Choose Application dialog. The change adds a small UrlOpener singleton next to InputDisabler that opens links with KIO::OpenUrlJob, which knows trash:/ is a folder and opens it in the file manager; web and file links still go to their usual apps.

commits.message:
applets/notifications: open the Trash link in the file manager

Clicking "Trash" in a file deletion notification asked to choose an app,
since body links went through Qt.openUrlExternally and no application
handles trash:/. Open them with KIO::OpenUrlJob, like other KDE links.

BUG: 527920
